idea-plugin.name: Gruvbox Material Islands
idea-plugin.description:
A warm, low-glare theme: the gruvbox-material palette (material foreground) on JetBrains' Islands layout, in four variants: dark soft, medium and hard, and light soft.

  • Warm syntax: no blue in code, no bold or italic, nothing contrasts more with the background than the text.
  • Moderate contrast: 6.7:1 to 9.1:1 for text on the background, by variant.
  • Dim tints for search results, diffs and usages instead of bright blocks.
  • Complete scheme: every editor key the IDE and its plugins define is set.
  • Islands layout: the 2026 JetBrains UI, recolored.
